style.styleTitle: Homcom 5ft Artificial Christmas Tree with 1620 Tips
style.toneOfVoice: Tired of the holiday rush and messy fallen needles when setting up your tree? The HOMCOM 5ft artificial Christmas tree turns holiday prep into a smooth, enjoyable moment. Featuring 1620 dense PE and PVC hinged branch tips, it opens quickly for a full, realistic look without the cleanup. Built with flame-retardant materials and a stable fir wood base, this tree keeps active homes safe while bringing warm, natural festive charm to your seasonal celebrations. . The classic Christmas tree design features a full-bodied profile with 1620 branch tips; . Crafted with realistic PE and dense PVC leaves for long-lasting natural beauty; . Hinged tips drop automatically, making shaping quicker than normal trees; . Sectional trunks make storage compact once festivities end; . Flame-retardant branch tips help slow accidental fire spread for safer celebrations; . A solid fir wood base delivers robust stability and adds an elevated, textured natural look; . Versatile seasonal accent infuses an authentic forest touch and a vibrant holiday atmosphere into any indoor layout; . Colour: Green; . Material: PE, PVC, Fir Wood; . Overall Dimensions: F85 x 150H cm; . Base Dimensions: F50 x 20H cm; . Branch Tip Count: 1620; . Item Label: 83C-286V00GN; . Shaping Note: Approx. 30-50 minutes of manual branch tips shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
